name: time-picker
title: Time picker
description: Pick a time of day with hour, minute and AM/PM segments, using the browser's own control.
a11y: Native input type="time": the browser exposes hour, minute and AM/PM as spinbuttons.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown change a segment, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or Tab move between segments, typing digits fills one.
The control takes its name from a label or aria-label; min, max and step are passed through.

props.name: value
props.description: 24-hour "HH:mm" (or "HH:mm:ss" when `step` is under 60), or '' for no time.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial time as 24-hour "HH:mm" when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new time as 24-hour "HH:mm" (or '' when cleared).

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). A surrounding Field sets this from its `error`.

usage: import {Field, TimePicker} from '@monoline/react';
